name: Sudharsan V S
headline: AI engineer building RAG pipelines, LLM agents and their evaluations
current_title: Data Engineer, Edvoy (designed its production AI workflow system and the initial architecture of its application automation)

experience.title: Data Engineer
highlights: Designed the architecture of an AI-assisted workflow automation system (n8n + Hermes + LangGraph) and built its workflow and pipeline; in production since October 2026: Jira-triggered, RAG over email threads, Slack alerts, and a decision directory with guardrails. Colleagues built some of its components.

Optimised the application automation once it went into production in May 2026: moved it to AWS, which ended the bot stalls; extended the pipeline to take new kinds of data without code changes; and brought a submission to about 5 minutes of bot time, against about 30 by hand. 3,400+ submissions to 70+ portals; about 95% of runs succeed.

experience.title: Junior Data Engineer
highlights: Designed the architecture of the initial RabbitMQ-based application automation; built its pipeline and logic and the university-specific configurations, and split it into three containers so one failing feature can't take the whole system down. Prototype released March 2026.
Built 25+ modular ETL pipelines that normalise heterogeneous external data into one internal format.
Built a real-time OTP event service on GCP Pub/Sub with webhooks, acknowledgement, duplicate detection and timeout handling, so emailed login codes stopped blocking the earlier automation.

across_the_role: Async Python and FastAPI services with idempotency, retries, failure recovery and duplicate prevention.
MongoDB (including centralised logging), AWS EC2 and S3, Docker and Docker Compose.
